title: E2E: verify bitmap import renders in Ruffle after publish
description: Bitmaps can be imported to the library and dragged to stage, but there is no Ruffle-based E2E test proving they render as visible pixels after publish. Task: write apps/desktop/e2e/bitmap-rendering.spec.ts that (1) imports a small PNG to the library via the MCP tool, (2) drags it onto the stage, (3) publishes the SWF, (4) screenshots Ruffle, (5) asserts the PNG pixels appear (non-white pixelDiff above threshold). Also verify DefineJpeg/DefineBitsLossless encoding in packages/swf/src/__tests__/ produces correct tags.
